article_title: From agriculture to AI-griculture: How tech is changing farming

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Why Northern Irish dairy farms are closing
How digital tools and AI are helping farmers monitor animals and run businesses
Why farmers want to replace cows with robots
How a new tractor linkage system was invented
tasks.correct_answer: How digital tools and AI are helping farmers monitor animals and run businesses
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציגה כמה דרכים שבהן AI, אפליקציות, רובוטיקה ואינטרנט מהיר משנים את עבודת החקלאים.

tasks.prompt: What does the CattleEye system do on George McMaster's farm?
options: It sells milk through an online shop.
It gives each cow an ID, records video and flags possible health changes.
It opens gates according to the weather.
It decides which cows must be sold.
tasks.correct_answer: It gives each cow an ID, records video and flags possible health changes.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המערכת מזהה כל פרה, מצלמת אותה מדי יום, מנתחת את הסרטון ומתריעה על שינויים אפשריים.

tasks.prompt: What did high-speed broadband allow Caleb Howard to add to his farm business?
options: A second herd of 300 cows
A cattle hospital
A farm shop with electronic payments
A university research centre
tasks.correct_answer: A farm shop with electronic payments
tasks.explanation_hebrew: החיבור המהיר אפשר להווארד לפתוח חנות משק עם מערכת תשלום אלקטרונית.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does it mean when the camera “flags” a change?
options: It hides the change from the farmer.
It proves the cow is seriously ill.
It stores the video without analysing it.
It draws attention to the change as something to check.
tasks.correct_answer: It draws attention to the change as something to check.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כאן flags פירושו מסמן שינוי ומפנה אליו את תשומת לב החקלאי לבדיקה.

tasks.prompt: Why does Gareth McDonald call FarmDrive “Facebook for cows”?
options: Each animal has a profile containing its records and possibly a photo.
Farmers use it mainly to share funny cattle videos.
The app lets cows choose their own feed online.
Every farm must publish its inspection reports publicly.
tasks.correct_answer: Each animal has a profile containing its records and possibly a photo.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ב-FarmDrive לכל פרה יש מעין פרופיל המרכז את הרשומות שלה ויכול לכלול תמונה.

tasks.prompt: What view of AI does Gareth McDonald express?
options: AI should make every farm decision without humans.
AI is useful only where broadband is unavailable.
AI should advise farmers with timely information, while people keep decision-making control.
AI will soon make farmers and advisers unnecessary.
tasks.correct_answer: AI should advise farmers with timely information, while people keep decision-making control.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מקדונלד רואה ב-AI יועץ שמציג מידע נכון בזמן הנכון, אך מדגיש שההחלטה צריכה להישאר בידי החקלאי.

tasks.prompt: Give two ways technology helps farmers identify or manage animal health.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שתי דרכים מבוססות כתבה שבהן הטכנולוגיה מסייעת לבריאות העדר.
expected_points: CattleEye records and analyses daily videos of individual cows.
The system can detect lameness before farmers notice it.
Earlier warnings let farmers check cows before they lose condition or become sick.
Digital profiles keep each animal's records together.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how technology changes both animal care and farm administration in 3–4 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להתייחס לפחות לכלי אחד לטיפול בבעלי חיים ולכלי אחד לניהול העסק, ולהסביר את התועלת.
expected_points: AI cameras can spot changes in cows, including possible lameness, early.
Robotic milking lets cows enter the machine when they choose.
FarmDrive replaces scattered paperwork with digital records and reports.
Broadband enables connected systems and electronic payments in rural areas.

tasks.prompt: Why is reliable broadband presented as part of agricultural innovation? Support your answer with two article details.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין תשתית האינטרנט להפעלת כלים דיגיטליים ולצמיחת עסקים כפריים, עם שתי ראיות.
expected_points: Poor rural phone and broadband service previously limited digital work.
Better broadband made systems simpler and easier to use.
It enabled Howard's farm shop to accept electronic payments.
Fibrus said connectivity helps rural businesses thrive.

tasks.prompt: Write a short recommendation to a farmer considering AI monitoring. Include one benefit and one limit described in the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לנסח המלצה מאוזנת, עם יתרון מבוסס כתבה ומגבלה שלפיה האדם נשאר מקבל ההחלטות.
expected_points: Mentions earlier detection of health problems or improved efficiency.
Explains that timely data can support better animal care or output.
States that AI should advise rather than make final decisions.
Uses clear, practical and evidence-based language.
